content: Claude Code plugin layout: <plugin>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (required manifest: name/version/description/author/repository/license), optional commands/, agents/, skills/, hooks/, .mcp.json, README.md. Marketplace: separate repo-root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json listing plugin entries with name+source; name is an immutable public slug, use displayName to relabel. Community marketplaces sometimes require CODEOWNERS+LICENSE.
